# ADATA Legend 840 1TB PCIe Gen4 x4 NVMe 1.4 M.2 Internal Gaming SSD Up to 5,000 MB/s (ALEG-840-1TCS)
Brand: ADATA
Category: Data Storage > Internal Solid State Drives

## Features
PCIe Gen4 x4 interface. NVMe 1.4 support; Excellent read/write performance 5,000/4,500 MB per second. Note Backward compatible with PCIe 3.0. If a third-generation PCIe motherboard is used, this product will be able to achieve sequential read/write speeds of 3400/3000MB per second; Heat sink keeps SSD 15% cooler for optimal performance and stability; With LDPC (Low Density Parity Check Code) and AES 256-bit encryption, the LEGEND 840 ensures accurate data transmissions and security; LEGEND series SSDs use only high quality ICs that have been rigorously tested. For further peace of mind, they come backed by a 5-year warranty

## Specifications
Color: LEGEND 840; Cache Memory Installed Size: 1; Additional Features: Portable; Digital Storage Capacity: 1 TB; Hard Disk Interface: NVMe

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.4 from 447 reviews.
Top review: Purchased strictly to upgrade internal storage for the PS5. Must be a Gen4 NVMe type SSD. Yes there are many other SSD's with slightly higher read/write speeds etc. that cost way more... But why spend more... the PS5 is limited to a specific speed which this ADATA 840 Legend meets.The installation on the PS5 is a Breeze... the hardest part was removing the Top Panel of the Console for the first time.So if you are on the Fence about this SSD working in the PS5....?? Trust me it does... and the performance is Fast just as Fast as the interal SSD built into the PS5

Status: In stock

The LEGEND 840 uses PCIe Gen4 x4 and NVMe 1.4 to give you stunning performance for seamless creative output. It works with the latest Intel and AMD platforms, including desktop PCs and laptops.

PCIe Gen4 x4 interface Excellent read/write performance Heat sink keeps things 15% cooler Great upgrade option for creators High capacities NVMe 1.4 support LDPC & AES 256-bit encryption 5-year warranty A New Era of Creativity

 The LEGEND 840 uses PCIe Gen4 x4 and NVMe 1.4 to give you stunning performance for seamless creative output. It works with the latest Intel and AMD platforms, including desktop PCs and laptops.

 Get Inspired Faster

 With read/write speeds of up to 5,000/4,500 MB per second, the LEGEND 840 is three times as fast as mainstream PCIe Gen3 SSDs and 15 times faster than SATA SSDs. It’s also backward compatible with current generation PCIe 3.0 platforms for creativity without limitations.

 Don’t Just Create. Play a Little too.

 The LEGEND 840 can also be installed on a PS5 as a secondary drive, giving you more storage space and smoothing game loading.

 *This product has been tested and confirmed to be compatible with PS5. Actual speed may vary depending on hardware and software configurations

 Cool Creations

 The LEGEND 840’s understated but elegant heat sink design is characterized by an elegant dark gray color scheme with an exquisite gold-colored trimming. The heat sink works to keep temperatures down by 15% for optimal performance and stability.

 Seamless Productivity

 Creativity can’t wait! The LEGEND 840 is equipped with SLC caching and HMB technology (Host Memory Buffer) for uninterrupted productivity. It’s maximum 4K random read/write is up to 650K/600K IOPS for effortless multitasking.

 Protecting Your Creations

 With LDPC (Low Density Parity Check Code) and AES 256-bit encryption, the LEGEND 840 ensures accurate data transmissions and security.

 5-Year Warranty

 LEGEND series SSDs use only high quality ICs that have been rigorously tested. For further peace of mind, they come backed by a 5-year warranty.
